title: Translation-Haar averaging yields a stationary non-orbit order-N4 descent

descent.stationarization: Translation-Haar averaging preserves the K1572 covariance and quartic defect and cannot increase weighted relative Fisher information.
descent.parameter_order: Fix g>0, choose the packet fraction alpha_g first, then choose one sufficiently small fixed t_g>0, and finally take N large.
descent.conclusion: There is c_g'>0 with Q_N<=lambda_N^statG-c_g'N^4, hence limsup E_N/N^4<=h_g^prof-c_g'.
descent.nonorbit: The law independently perturbs Theta(N^3) cardinal coordinates and is not a fixed translation/global-phase orbit mixture.
descent.scope_guard: This is a strict unrestricted upper bound, not the true coefficient, a matching lower bound, a minimizer, a continuum state or an E_N+O(1) recentering.
